description: This file defines the AssetRepository class in C#, which provides data access methods for CRUD operations, queries, and validation checks on assets and related entities in a PostgreSQL database within a data asset management system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting (soft delete), and validating associations of assets, asset properties, status logs, additional IDs, and related resources.

classes.name: AssetRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing CRUD operations, queries, and validation methods for assets and related entities.

classes.name: EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a requested entity (e.g., asset) is not found during validation.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset record in the database and returns its DTO.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an asset by ID, excluding soft-deleted entries.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset and returns the updated DTO.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Queries and returns a list of assets based on optional filter parameters.

methods.name: AssetExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a non-deleted asset by ID.

methods.name: SoftDeleteAssetGraphAsync
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on an asset and cascades the delete to dependent related tables within a transaction.

methods.name: InputParameterBelongsToAssetAsync
methods.description: Checks whether a specific input parameter belongs to an asset.

methods.name: ThroughputEquationBelongsToInputAsync
methods.description: Checks whether a throughput equation belongs to a specific input parameter.

methods.name: WouldParentInputMappingCreateCycleAsync
methods.description: Detects if creating a parent-child mapping would introduce a cycle in hierarchy.

methods.name: ReportingAttributeCombinationExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks for duplicate reporting attribute combinations under an asset.

methods.name: GetLatestStatusToDateAsync
methods.description: Fetches the most recent status_to_date for an asset, excluding soft-deleted rows.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates a new status log entry for an asset.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Lists all status logs for an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific status log entry under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing status log entry under an asset.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Creates an additional ID record linked to an asset.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists all additional IDs linked to an asset.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific additional ID under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates a specific additional ID record under an asset.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates a property entry for an asset.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists all properties for an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property for an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates a property record for an asset.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a mapping between an asset and a control device.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists all control device mappings under an asset.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific device mapping under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a device mapping under an asset.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates an input parameter for an asset.

methods.name: ListInputParametersAsync
methods.description: Lists all input parameters for an asset.

methods.name: GetInputParameterByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific input parameter under an asset.

methods.name: CreateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a parent input mapping for a given child input parameter id.

methods.name: ListParentInputMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists parent input mappings for a given child input parameter id (excluding soft-deleted rows).

methods.name: UpdateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a parent input mapping under a child input parameter scope (returns null if not found/under input).

methods.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a reporting attribute mapping under an asset.

methods.name: ListReportingAttributeMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists reporting attribute mappings for an asset (excluding soft-deleted rows).

methods.name: GetReportingAttributeMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Gets a reporting attribute mapping under an asset scope (returns null if not found/under asset).

methods.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a reporting attribute mapping under an asset scope (returns null if not found/under asset).

methods.name: CreateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates an EF source mapping under an input parameter.

methods.name: ListEfSourceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists EF source mappings under an input parameter (excluding soft-deleted rows).

methods.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates an EF source mapping under an input parameter scope (returns null if not found/under input).

methods.name: CreateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput equation under an input parameter.

methods.name: ListThroughputEquationsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput equations under an input parameter (excluding soft-deleted rows).

methods.name: UpdateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput equation under an input parameter scope (returns null if not found/under input).

methods.name: CreateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput scalar under a throughput equation.

methods.name: ListThroughputScalarsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput scalars under a throughput equation (excluding soft-deleted rows).

methods.name: UpdateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput scalar under a throughput equation scope (returns null if not found/under equation).

methods.name: CreateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Creates a data input value under an input parameter.

methods.name: ListDataInputValuesAsync
methods.description: Lists data input values under an input parameter (excluding soft-deleted rows).

methods.name: UpdateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Updates a data input value under an input parameter scope (returns null if not found/under input).
